digest.component_or_area: pytest configuration and CI test execution
propositions: The per-test hang budget was incorrectly lowered from 300s to 20s in commit 6a5c88027c5, falling inside the legitimate 18.7–29.93s cost band of whole-tree-scan tests on coverage-enabled CI legs, causing worker crashes.
With timeout_method=thread, pytest-timeout calls os._exit(1) to kill the entire xdist worker process rather than reporting a Failed: Timeout verdict, making the timeout invisible in CI output.
The zero 'Failed: Timeout' count in failing CI runs is a structural prediction of the thread-method crash mechanism, not evidence that the budget is sound.
Approximately 11–14 xdist workers died per run at the 20s budget on the ubuntu-latest py3.13 coverage leg, and the crashing test set drifted between runs due to workload distribution variance.
Coverage adds a measured ~2x multiplier to test execution time locally, making a budget calibrated on a fast box without coverage insufficient for the gating CI lanes.

Change 2115's initial failure occurred because the Verified gate executes workflow files from trusted main (GitHub-documented behavior), and pytest-timeout precedence CLI > INI meant main's stale --timeout=20 flag overrode the patchset's ini=300 value, making config-only fixes ineffective in their own gate runs.
